arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Verrilli stated infringement is the only significant use of the services.
Mr. Taranto argued the software has large and growing legitimate uses.
Mr. Clement claimed the lower decision allows businesses to build on infringement.
Mr. Verrilli described the situation as a shell game.
